summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for singleton Client initialization in AgentOps, with unique semantic identity (singleton pattern for Client lifecycle management). It does not match any existing skill in asset_type, task_family, or method_family. Peer candidates (Jupyter detection, callback handler, session span) are complementary initialization steps in different task families, not overlapping or conflicting. No existing skill covers singleton Client instantiation with trace context and session state management.
